description: This Java class 'SurveyValidator' performs validation of 'Survey' objects, including their questions and responses, using a DataValidatorBuilder and collecting validation errors to throw exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: SurveyValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating Survey objects, including their questions and responses, and throwing validation exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided Survey object, checking key fields and questions, and triggers exception if validation errors are found.

methods.name: validateQuestions
methods.description: Validates the list of questions within a survey, including their keys, text, description, and responses.

methods.name: validateOptions
methods.description: Validates the responses (options) for a question, including text and value constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a PlatformApiDataValidationException if there are any validation errors collected.
